card.name: Words just before a possessive noun
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words that come right before a possessive and its noun, such as 'of' before 'your restaurant', 'in case' before 'their disease', or 'run' before 'a business'. It is general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Preposition before owner
modes.description: 'of' or 'in case' right before a possessive phrase naming whose thing it is.
modes.example: specific costs in the operation<< of>> your restaurant, log on to http://

modes.label: Verb or adverb before possessed noun
modes.description: A verb or timing word followed by his, their, or a thing someone owns or runs.
modes.example: to get favours, permissions and licenses to run<< their>> businesses.

modes.label: Before 'his' in time phrases
modes.description: A word like 'before' just ahead of 'his death'.
modes.example: Although his success lasted only a year and a half before<< his>> death in an airplane crash

card.writes: It lowers 'personally', 'personal' and 'individual', and raises 'self' and 'itself', which favors reflexive or own-possession wording.
card.plain: It fires on little words that sit just before something belonging to a person or entity, like 'their business' or 'your restaurant'.
